events.title: England open their World Cup campaign with a 1–1 draw against Sweden in Group F.
In a watershed moment for soccer in the United States , the United States men's national soccer team upsets pre-tournament favorites Portugal 3–2, in their opening match of the 2002 FIFA World Cup .

A 데이비드 베컴 penalty gives England a 1–0 win over Argentina in their second World Cup fixture. 맨체스터 시티 prepare for their Premier League comeback by paying a club record £13 million for 파리 생제르맹 striker 니콜라 아넬카 , who spent most of last season on loan at 리버풀.
Croatia beats Italy 2–1 at the 2002 FIFA World Cup .
England secure qualification for the last 16 of the World Cup with a 0–0 draw against Nigeria .

Astrophysics – An asteroid ( 2002 MN ), the size of a soccer field, passed the Earth at a distance of about 120,000 km. It was the second closest asteroid approach to Earth in recorded history. The asteroid was first observed three days after its close approach, on June 17, 2002.
England defeat Denmark 3–0 in the World Cup second round.
Despite taking a 23rd-minute lead thanks to 마이클 오언 , England's World Cup campaign ends in the quarter-finals with a 2–1 defeat to Brazil .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 pay £8.5 million for 19-year-old Portuguese midfielder 우구 비아나 from 스포르팅 .
리버풀 sign El Hadji Diouf from Lens for £10 million.

리즈 유나이티드 sack manager David O'Leary after four years in charge. The sacking is thought by many to be down to a combination of both spending more than £100 million on players but never winning a trophy and the publication of his book "리즈 유나이티드 on Trial", detailing his experiences as manager during the previous season when both Lee Bowyer and Johnathan Woodgate had been on trial for assault.
The Final of the 2002 FIFA World Cup took place in Yokohama , Japan . Brazil defeated Germany and claimed the title for a record fifth time.
